title: Three Years and One Short Tank
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（人与自然·环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（人与自然·环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：hydrogen　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hydrogen 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1998 the chemist ① produced the hydrogen that no technician in the laboratory would have measured, and he said the producing was the whole of the year. The ② hydrogen, meaning the fuel itself and not the tank, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; hydrogen, he said, is the only thing in a laboratory that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ kind of hydrogen in that laboratory had the same short tank beside it, and the ④ hydrogen at the far pipe, meaning the flame they kept for the children to see and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Hydrogen, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the chemist said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hydrogen was the whole of the matter, meaning the power and not the fuel. The ⑥ hydrogen, meaning the power and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; hydrogen, he said, is either something you produce or the only word that means both fuel and a power. He said the power is the part they remember.

By 2003 the ⑦ hydrogen had become a line in a invoice, and the invoice had become an argument about the short tank. The ⑧ hydrogen of the whole thing, the chemist wrote in October, was one laboratory and three years of measuring; hydrogen, he said, is either the flame at the far pipe or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hydrogen I remember is the hydrogen measured in the invoice, which closed in 2005 and is still measured as the quietest in the laboratory. ⑩ Hydrogen, my mother said in 2007, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all hydrogen, she said, is a power that has agreed to look like fuel. She said the power was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 氢；氢气（指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 氢；氢气（指那份燃料本身，与气罐相对）
C. 固定搭配：produce the hydrogen 制取氢气
D. n. 氢；氢气（指留给孩子们看的那一簇那一份）
E. n. 能源之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的氢气之事）
F. n. 氢；氢气（指发票里写到、被量过的的那一份）
G. n. 动力、能量（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 能量（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: produced the hydrogen that no technician in the laboratory would have measured
The hydrogen, meaning the fuel itself and not the tank

the hydrogen at the far pipe

answers.why: produce the hydrogen 意为“制取氢气”，1998 年那位化学家把实验室里没有一位技术员肯测量的一部分氢气做了一遍。
hydrogen 意为“氢；氢气”，指那份燃料本身而不是气罐，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被测量。
hydrogen 意为“氢；氢气”，指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只小小的气罐。
hydrogen 意为“氢；氢气”，指最远那段管道留给孩子们看的那一簇那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hydrogen 意为“动力、能量”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份动力就是那件事的全部。
hydrogen 意为“能量”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份燃料，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hydrogen 意为“氢；氢气”，指发票里写到、被量过的的那一份，到 2003 年这一份成了发票里的一行。
hydrogen 意为“能源之事”，化学家十月写道，整件事的氢气之事是一处实验室和三个年的测量。
hydrogen 意为“氢；氢气”，我记得的是发票里测量过的那一份，2005 年用完了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一份。
hydrogen 为抽象总称，母亲 2007 年说，氢气是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的燃料。
